name: Capability Fulfilled Before Start
description: A Deliverable moves from Defined to In Progress only after the Capability that produces it is fulfilled. A Deliverable that has no producing Capability is not held.

conditions.statement: The Capability that produces the Deliverable is Fulfilled before the Deliverable moves from Defined to In Progress.

requiredEvidence.title: Capability Fulfilment Record
requiredEvidence.description: The active Capability Fulfilment of the Capability that produces the Deliverable.
